growth_request_preparation.purpose: Pokemon trading-card market pricing and index analytics
growth_request_preparation.data_use: derive per-card active-ask and (if approved) sold-price evidence for pricing indexes; no resale of raw listings; no seller usernames stored (SHA-256 seller keys only)
growth_request_preparation.retention: normalized evidence rows kept; raw provider responses kept on the VM only
growth_request_preparation.expected_volume: V1 ~150 targets/day at ~7 Browse calls each (about 1,000/day); V2 sold+active targets sized to the approved quota
growth_request_preparation.efficiency: search shallow (limit small, category-filtered) then selective getItem; one representative ask per seller; stop at 5 eligible sellers; persistent DB ledger prevents overspend
growth_request_preparation.privacy_security: application token only (no user data); secrets in environment/backend/.env; RLS on all tables; anon/authenticated denied
